system_thesis_interpretation: Scientific verdict: PASS for proposal-stage deliberation, with no unresolved scientific ambiguity and no execution authority. V5 preserves the V4 question: conditional on correctness-selected child-authored endpoints, can four isolated target-masked LoRAs across two engineered-disjoint roots carry complementary sixteen-key seen tool-by-mode endpoint policies under held renderings without exceeding four prespecified spill-family limits? The four changes are authority and lifecycle repairs, not interventions on the model, source data, DREAM derivative, writer dose, evaluation panels, estimands, thresholds, or claim. THINK remains provenance for already-achieved endpoints; DREAM still projects only visible tool, visible mode, a neutral endpoint frame, and the exact final ACT; SLEEP remains the same isolated matched-complement LoRA write. No causal benefit of child authorship or public outcome is identified, and there is no claim about autonomous credit assignment, reasoning-path learning, unseen-key generalization, arbitrary policy capacity, retention, qualification, parenting, C11, population behavior, or the organism as a whole. The human directive is respected because this proposal neither blocks ordinary scouts nor implements the parked paper-grade C11 guard.
graph_delta_interpretation: The inherited scientific graph is unchanged. Each of R0 and R1 still has 24 candidate tools split into two fixed twelve-tool orientation strata, two visible modes, and complementary M+/M- assignments; the lowest four eligible tools per stratum yield sixteen selected keys, eight targets per action, and 32 retained endpoints per mirror world. The four repairs close representational or capability edges around that graph. First, RUNNING becomes the residual source-started, nonterminal, incompletely labelled state, so compilation, fit preparation, the four-commit barrier, selection, and all inter-stage checkpoints cannot fall outside the receipt algebra. Second, source, fit, and evaluation dispatchers become explicit phase-minimal capability holders rather than an implicit shared executor. Third, the selector derives canonical IDs from final admission plus the sealed index, verifies the bank root, dereferences only selected immutable entries, verifies each selected entry hash, and emits order-preserving calls; this makes selected prompt exposure constructible without granting unselected-content access. Fourth, global first-source timing controls the run lifecycle while each root's first request separately controls that root's eligibility for SOURCE_INVALID, preventing a fault in an untouched root from becoming fabricated scientific evidence. None changes the matched W+/W- intervention or OFF contrast, and every shared V4 visibility cell retains its original value and reason.
loop_delta_interpretation: The temporal loop remains freeze and predeclare; render and seal the complete candidate-local evaluation bank before source; acquire all fixed source trajectories without semantic retry; reduce paired eligibility and select lowest ordinals; compile byte-exact final ACT targets with read-only admission; prove matched complement geometry; fit and hash-commit four separate adapters only under later authority; open selected held bytes only after final admission and all four commits; execute immutable selected calls; and reduce immutable results one way. V5 makes that loop total: PLANNED and NOT_RUN exhaust source_started=false according to whether a preflight failure terminalized; TERMINAL_LABELED applies exactly when both labels exist; STOPPED_UNLABELED and RUNNING partition source_started=true states with a missing label by terminal_stop. Inherited rules keep pre-source labels null, scientific_pair non-null exactly for two labels, and run_pass true only for the ordered pair [MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS,MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS]. Untouched-root faults after the other root starts stop the run without assigning the untouched root a label. The unchanged selected-run maxima independently recompute to 1,536 source trajectories, 3,072 source emissions, four fits over 512 items and 262,144 training token-passes, 768 primary emissions, 256 oracle emissions, 768 spill emissions, at most 192 interface emissions across 48 tasks, and 768 plus 768 teacher-forced candidate sequence scores. Generation totals are therefore at most 5,056 emissions and 102,400 new tokens, with a pre-source conservative projection no greater than 3.0 A40-hours. No model, tokenizer, source, training, adapter, or GPU work is authorized by this interpretation.
claim_delta_interpretation: The estimands and decision boundaries remain exactly V4. Teacher-forced L_z is the unnormalized exact-continuation token-log-probability sum; q_z(k) is the four-form mean of within-form a+ minus a- log likelihood, I_k=q_W+(k)-q_W-(k), and mean_I is the ordered equal-key mean. The directional gate is a per-key conjunction q_W+(k)>=0.50 and q_W-(k)<=-0.50 on at least 12/16 keys including 6/8 in each stratum; mean_I>=1.00; and the exhaustive 4^8=65,536 stratified tool-cluster fixed-panel statistic, defined as the 3,277th one-based sorted resample mean, must be strictly positive. It is a fixed-panel stability check, not a confidence interval. For each adapter/key, d_s(k) is the midpoint median of four paired held-target log-likelihood gains over OFF, not a difference of medians; all d_s(k)>=0.50 and abs(mu_+-mu_-)<=0.25, with equality passing. Generated own-map balanced accuracy must be at least 0.80, each orientation-stratum accuracy at least 0.75, mirrored tau at least 0.50, and mirrored gain g over OFF at least 0.20. Oracle strict accuracy must be at least 0.90 separately by root, map, and stratum. Fitted own-map strict validity must be at least 0.95 overall and 0.875 per stratum; fitted primary multi-ACT and any of the sixteen fitted interface-task violations trigger the structural invalid label, while OFF, oracle, and spill multi-ACT outputs are nonvetoing diagnostics in their declared roles. For each adapter and each of four spill families, the all-32-trial signed legal-ACT-presence increase delta and the equal-prompt conditional-action TV must each be at most 0.05. All sums, medians, logsumexp operations, component subtractions, orders, non-finite precedence, and comparisons retain the exact binary64 rules and authoritative hexadecimal thresholds 0.05=0x1.999999999999ap-5, 0.20=0x1.999999999999ap-3, 0.25=0x1.0000000000000p-2, 0.50=0x1.0000000000000p-1, 0.75=0x1.8000000000000p-1, 0.80=0x1.999999999999ap-1, 0.875=0x1.c000000000000p-1, 0.90=0x1.ccccccccccccdp-1, 0.95=0x1.e666666666666p-1, and 1.00=0x1.0000000000000p+0. The future permitted reading remains only two-root, correctness-selected, supervised endpoint-policy carriage on sixteen seen keys with the named gates and bounded control families; it does not say every key passed, that spill is globally absent, that roots are population samples, or that any current result exists.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is structurally exact: 11 information items by 15 stages gives 165 unique cells, consisting of all 120 V4 cells with identical visibility values and reasons plus 45 cells induced by selected_execution_call and the three dispatchers. The only new dispatcher allowlists are scientifically appropriate. The source dispatcher can see the continuing public trajectory and its execution capability, but no map, admission, training, adapter, evaluation, result, score, or selected-call object. The fit dispatcher can see committed compiled rows, its own adapter stage state, and fit capability, but no map, admission, lived history, held bank, other adapter, result, or score. The evaluation dispatcher can see exactly one selected_execution_call, execution capability, and the raw result it writes, but no direct map, admission, full bank/index, selected prompt object, training row, lived history, adapter-stage object, prior result, or scorer state. The selector alone writes the selected call after the final-admission and four-commit barrier and selected-only hash-verified dereference; oracle, ordinary, and teacher-forced principals receive only the prompt or continuation byte projections and not condition, seed, adapter, envelope metadata, or capability. The scorer remains one-way and result-late. Denial through aliases, metadata, logs, exceptions, filenames, caches, mutation, feedback, reseeding, reordering, retries, or cross-phase capability sharing is explicit. This repair reduces leakage and adaptive-evaluation risk without changing what is estimated.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG5_T01 inherits every V4 deterministic geometry, complete-bank, seed-relation, and workload check and adds immutable dispatcher-call identity, condition, seed, order, hash, and call-graph fixtures. MWG5_T02 preserves every V4 visibility mutation and must prove the exact 165-cell product, phase allowlists, forbidden ingress and feedback, alias channels, selected-only dereference, and denial of unselected content. MWG5_T03 preserves the exact two-emission source overlay, paired mirror eligibility, lowest-ordinal selection, publication, and no-repair/no-replacement rule while exhaustively separating global source_started from both root-local first-request receipts. MWG5_T04 and T05 retain without change the complement/write geometry and total raw-byte parser plus stage-overlay semantics. MWG5_T06 retains every exact numeric, label, nullable-pair, and run_pass fixture and adds exactly-one lifecycle classification at all named pre-source, inter-stage, stopped, and terminal checkpoints. MWG5_T07 retains all V4 path, capability, retry, failure, resource, and foreign-root isolation tests while adding dispatcher, immutable-envelope, selected-only, residual-RUNNING, and untouched-root fault injection. MWG5_T08 requires fresh review of identical V5 evidence before another human gate; this is additive to, and cannot waive, the repository-level requirement that a later immutable execution manifest and receipts receive a fresh independent review plus a separate author-side scientific advocate before exact human execution ratification. The normative inherited V4 scope still requires all T01-T07 deterministic evidence before any model, tokenizer, source, fit, adapter, or GPU execution, regardless of the coarser required_before tags in the architecture record. Together T01-T08 test every inherited scientific invariant and the four repairs; passing them would establish readiness for the next human decision, not a scientific result.
assumptions: The V5 statement that every V4 scientific and authority boundary remains unchanged is normative: any later manifest or implementation must instantiate deferred identities, bytes, seeds, runtime bindings, retries, loads, projections, and receipts without modifying V4 geometry, estimands, thresholds, workload, parser, reducer order, visibility, or claim scope.
The directional teacher-forced count is applied to the per-key conjunction q_W+(k)>=0.50 and q_W-(k)<=-0.50 before counting 12/16 and 6/8 per stratum, as required by the inherited permitted reading.

Bank-root verification is performed from the sealed index and committed per-entry hashes without reading unselected payload bytes; content verification dereferences and hashes only canonical selected entries.

Trial-level ERROR or TRUNCATED observations assigned to fixed denominators remain distinct from a stage-level infrastructure or evaluation failure, so denominator zeros cannot be reclassified as lifecycle stops or vice versa.

The phrase two fresh independent reviewers in MWG5_T08 does not remove the separate author-side scientific advocate required by AGENTS.md and the inherited V4 pre-execution authority boundary; if the V5 reviews are used at the later execution gate, the required advocate remains additional unless explicitly and validly fulfilled by a distinct artifact.
